description: This file implements the StreamBufferCache class, which manages a cache of stream buffers for camera hardware, providing methods to get, remove, update, clear, and selectively remove stream buffers based on stream IDs.

classes.name: StreamBufferCache
classes.description: A class that manages a cache of stream buffers, allowing for thread-safe access and modification of cached buffers.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached stream buffer by its buffer ID.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a stream buffer from the cache by its buffer ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Adds a new stream buffer to the cache or updates an existing one based on buffer ID.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all stream buffers from the cache.

methods.name: removeStreamsExcept
methods.description: Removes all stream buffers except those associated with specified stream IDs.
